variety_description: NDUAT, Faizabad, developed this variety in 1992 and recommended for UP, Odisha, and West Bengal. Early in maturity, dwarf with long slender grain, is ideal for direct-seeded rice in rainfed and upland growing environments. Low yield with low HRR. Because of its suitability in water deficit areas, this variety is quite popular in large tracts of UP and Madhya Pradesh. Tolerant to major diseases and insect pests
